resolution_notes: base_url: verifier correction adopted. Metro Transit's current OpenAPI lists all routes under /nextrip, including /nextrip/routes: https://svc.metrotransit.org/swagger/docs/v2/nextrip. example: verifier correction adopted. The official reference specifies GET https://svc.metrotransit.org/nextrip/routes: https://metrotransit.readme.io/reference/get_nextrip-routes; Metro Transit's 2026 production log records that request returning 200 and the shown JSON fields: https://rts.metrotransit.org/log.
